title: Date range defaults to This Month and changing it re-fetches the report with a loading indicator
preconditions: 1. Your browser has no remembered settings for this report (first visit or cleared storage).
steps: 1. Open the report and read the date range picker.
2. Change the range to Last Month and watch the table.
expected: 1. On first load the date range defaults to "This Month."
2. Changing the range re-fetches and re-renders the report; the standard loading indicator (centered spinner over the data area) shows during the fetch.
